questions.topic: A Class And The Object Made From It

questions.stem: A team ticket defines class Point with x=3 and y=4; p=Point(); what is p.x plus p.y?

answer.exemplar: A class defines attributes and methods as a template, while an object is a concrete instance created from that template with its own state.
